analysis: 源自拉丁语 exemptus，为 eximere（ex- 出 + emere 取）的过去分词，字面义为“被取出的”，故引申为“被免除的、豁免的”。

meanings.meaning_en: free from an obligation or duty that others must fulfil
examples: Students with medical certificates are exempt from physical education classes.

meanings.meaning_en: to officially free someone from an obligation or duty
examples: The new law exempts small businesses from paying the tax.
